data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'oikos', Hoem symbolizes the concept of 'home' and 'hearth'. It is a name deeply rooted in the Christian tradition, reminding us of the warmth and comfort of God's love and the security of our spiritual home. The name Hoem carries the meaning “Home, hearth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hoem usually hope their child will grow to embody home, hearth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
